## Director increment · batch #388 item 4 · 2026-10-24T00:29Z

Director seat, summon #49 (session `session_0162wFwDdLFGhaSvDdSnZ9Sx`, account `os-zhuang`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; ledger objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a ruling. This card had no four-facet block; the block below is the seat's, one line per facet across the seven items. Readings are from objectstack `origin/main` `45f996231ea4` and cloud `origin/main` `c3675e2ad7d6`.

**Premise re-check and the seat's letter, item by item:**

1. **#25442 (scheduled flows on hosted environments) — the premise is false for paid plans; the seat differs from the triage leaning and recommends a new letter D: nothing to build.** cloud `packages/objectos-runtime/src/plan-entitlements.ts:294` `planRunsScheduledWork(plan)` returns `!isFreePlan(plan)`, and `scheduledWorkPolicyForPlan` injects a per-kernel `ScheduledWorkPolicy` through the framework seam objectstack#19834 (`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts:153`, `per-kernel-scheduled-work-policy.test.ts`). The Free plan's OFF carries `SCHEDULED_FLOWS_FREE_PLAN_REASON` = "scheduled flows do not run on the Free plan — upgrade to Team or above to run them." (`packages/plan-vocabulary/src/index.ts:394`; ruling C on cloud#2337). So a hosted environment on Team or above already runs package-authored `schedule` and `time_relative` flows; the switch the card calls deployment-wide is overridden per kernel by plan on cloud. The evaluation's "disabled by deployment policy" came from the local verify stack with the variable unset, and its hosted sentence quotes ruling G on #17396 rather than a hosted measurement. Ruling G (multi-tenant kernels stay OFF) is untouched by this reading. D = close #25442 as answered (not planned; the reading in the closing comment), hotsrm's docs say "scheduled flows need a paid plan", #20645 stays on hold. B (a per-environment admin switch for Free) would be a cloud pricing decision, not a platform gap. Workload D: 0.
2. **#25443 (one position per supplier) — agree B, close as a duplicate of #25234.** Ruling 6355640929 on #25234 (letter A) line 19: hotsrm "must not launch on per-supplier positions in the meantime". Workload 0.
3. **#25444 (notify an applicant who is not a user) — agree B.** `packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts:547` `recipients: NotifyRecipientsSlotSchema` resolves users (tests use CEL `record.owner`); ADR-0012 `:206` already maps a resolved recipient to an email address on the email channel, so the transport speaks addresses and only the recipient model lacks a raw-address form. Closed form on ③: the new recipient form names an `email`-typed field of the triggering record, never a free string; rate-limited per address, written to the messaging log. Protocol addition → spec first, p1 by the card's own rule. Workload M (spec, service-messaging, lint).
4. **#25445 (guest file upload on a public form) — agree B, ADR first.** ADR-0138's door list has no guest upload (`:748` names only the signed token an authorized upload mints). Anonymous write of bytes is a security boundary and sits on the human floor regardless. Workload: ADR S, then M–L.
5. **#25446 (approver may not be the submitter) — agree B, default off.** `excludeSubmitter` has 0 hits in `packages` (control: the approver kinds list hits in `approval.test.ts:25`, `:268`); `approval.zod.ts:107` already names a node-level `onEmptyApprovers` fallback, so the exclusion feeds an existing fallback instead of inventing an escalation. C (default on) silently reroutes every existing approval. Workload S–M.
6. **#25447 (public form bound to one organization, ADR-0138 D5) — letter B is the end state, but the timing is a hold; the seat differs from the leaning on timing only.** ADR-0138 D5 (`:459`) is "Ruled: Q5 A — shape only, built when demand arrives… The trigger is a named deployment that needs it." It is planned, not rejected. hotsrm itself writes that invited registration is acceptable for v0.2. So: B, `pm:on-hold` with `Restart-when: a named hosted deployment (a hotsrm public-notice release or a cloud customer) asks for per-organization public forms`. The maintainer can reply "B now" to pre-build. Workload when built: M.
7. **#25470 (edit all records without delete) — agree A, with the existing route documented.** `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts:76–83` `MODIFY_ALL_WRITE_KEYS` = allowEdit, allowDelete, allowTransfer; `:289` the write bypass is `modifyAllRecords` alone; `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts:214` is the same fold. Spec and runtime agree (Salesforce "Modify All"), so `allowDelete: false` beside `modifyAllRecords: true` is an authoring contradiction the schema accepts and ignores, not a declared-but-unenforced key. The Salesforce-faithful shape for "edit all, delete none" already exists in the protocol: a `criteria` sharing rule with `accessLevel: 'edit'` to the buyer position (`packages/spec/src/security/sharing.zod.ts:35`, `:76`; ADR-0111 D3 removed edit-share delete) on a `public_read` object, whose effective model `read` is an enforcing posture (ADR-0111 D7). Whether a rule's `condition` can select every row is unverified — the dev checks it first and the docs name the route. A = refuse the contradiction loudly at publish and in lint, document the sharing-rule route; B rewrites the security fold. Workload A: S; B: M.

**Summary of letters:** #25442 D (new) · #25443 B · #25444 B · #25445 B · #25446 B · #25447 B held · #25470 A. The maintainer may answer per item or 「同意」 for all seven as listed here.

**After the ruling (the card's own execution section applies):** #25443 closes as duplicate of #25234; #25442 closes not planned with the reading; #25447 moves to `pm:on-hold` with the `Restart-when:` line; #25444 and #25470 queue to `domain:spec` (p1 protocol addition; p2), #25445 queues an ADR card first, #25446 queues to `domain:server`. Each of the seven leaves `pm:awaiting-maintainer` in that same stroke (they carry it today without a `Maintainer-action:` line, which the state model does not allow).

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：#25442 D 不加开关、不推翻裁决 G；#25443 B 并入已裁路线；#25444 B 收件人形态进协议一次；#25445 B 先立 ADR 再动匿名写入；#25446 B 用已有空审批人回退，不另造升级；#25447 B 是 ADR 已定的终态、按 ADR 自己的触发时机做；#25470 A 保持 Salesforce 语义、把矛盾声明变成响亮拒绝、文档指向已有的共享规则路线。
- ② 实际业务拉动：#25442 付费套餐今天就能跑，拉动来自对本地栈的误读；#25443 零（已裁）；#25444/#25446/#25470 各有两处 hotsrm 实测；#25445 有实测但碰安全边界；#25447 hotsrm 自述 v0.2 不需要、尚无具名部署。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：#25444 收件人只许记录的 email 字段，不许自由串；#25446 默认关，开了才改路由；#25470 发布时拒绝自相矛盾的权限行、lint 同步；#25445 匿名上传只认表单声明的文件字段。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：七项里两项零工作量（#25442 D、#25443 B）、一项 hold（#25447），只有四项真开工；全部不加门禁；#25470 选 A 不加键。
Prior rulings read: ruling G #17396 (5642381255), cloud#2337 ruling C, #25234 (6355640929), #25233 (6355206139), #25251, ADR-0138 D5, ADR-0111 D3/D7, ADR-0042, ADR-0012 → 9 ruling/ADR hits; thread: none (the card has no comments)

### 维护者速读
席位意见与分诊倾向相比，改两处：
- **#25442 改为 D「不用做」**：托管环境的 Team 及以上套餐今天就能跑定时流程（cloud 按套餐逐内核放行，Free 版关着并显示"升级到 Team"的原因句）。评估是在本地栈上量的，托管那句引的是旧裁决。关卡、文档写明"定时流程需要付费套餐"即可。
- **#25447 改为 B 但先挂起**：ADR-0138 D5 本来就写好了"有具名部署提出需求时再做"，hotsrm 自己也说 v0.2 用邀请注册就够。等有具名部署再派。你若想现在就做，回「25447 B 现在做」。
其余五项同意分诊倾向：#25443 B（关为 #25234 重复）、#25444 B、#25445 B（ADR 先行）、#25446 B（默认关）、#25470 A（发布时拒绝矛盾组合，文档指向共享规则路线）。可逐项回字母，或回「同意」按本席列表执行。

Ruling: batch #388 item 4 · letter 25442 D · 25443 B · 25444 B · 25445 B · 25446 B · 25447 B (held) · 25470 A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-24T00:47Z

Director seat, summon #49 (session `session_0162wFwDdLFGhaSvDdSnZ9Sx`, account `os-zhuang`, in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` — this seat submits no review and clicks nothing; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; ledger objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708, opening mark 6377506702). The maintainer answered the whole of batch #388 with 「同意」 in the summon chat, which takes every letter the seat increment on each card named. For this card the increment is 6377530193; the letters it named differ from the triage leaning on #25442 (D, new) and on #25447 (B, timing held), and agree on the other five.

Governing text, per item: ruling G on #17396 (5642381255, addendum 5642795312) and cloud#2337 ruling C (the per-plan policy, `packages/plan-vocabulary/src/index.ts:394`); ruling 6355640929 on #25234 (letter A, line 19: hotsrm must not launch on per-supplier positions); ADR-0012 (recipient resolver, `:206`); ADR-0138 D2 door list and D5 (`:459`, "shape only, built when demand arrives"); ADR-0042 and the approval node's `onEmptyApprovers` fallback (`packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts:107`); ADR-0111 D3 and D7 with the permission fold `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts:214`.

**What the ruling binds, item by item:**
1. **#25442 → D, nothing to build.** On cloud, scheduled work is armed per kernel by plan: `planRunsScheduledWork(plan)` is `!isFreePlan(plan)` (cloud `packages/objectos-runtime/src/plan-entitlements.ts:294`) through the framework seam of objectstack#19834 (`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts:153`); Team and above run package-authored `schedule` and `time_relative` flows today, Free is off with the sentence "scheduled flows do not run on the Free plan — upgrade to Team or above to run them." Ruling G (multi-tenant kernels stay off) is untouched. The card closes not planned with this reading; hotsrm's docs owe one line "scheduled flows need a paid plan" (the hotsrm seat writes it — this session has no hotsrm access). #20645 stays `pm:on-hold`.
2. **#25443 → B.** Closed as a duplicate of #25234, whose ruling A already covers per-supplier isolation with roster records and `membershipKeys` and forbids the per-supplier-position route. Workload 0.
3. **#25444 → B.** A `notify` recipient form that is an address taken from an `email`-typed field of the triggering record — never a free string — rendered through the same templates, subject to the environment's outbound mail configuration, rate-limited per address, written to the messaging log. Protocol addition: spec first, then `service-messaging` and lint. Priority p1 by the card's own rule (protocol addition). Workload M.
4. **#25445 → B, ADR first.** The ADR-0138 amendment declares a guest upload door bound to a public form: accepted only for the form's declared file fields, size and type limited by the field, stored unattached under the form's organization (D4), attached by the submission that follows or garbage-collected after a short TTL; the form's anti-abuse posture applies. Then the implementation. Priority p1 (protocol addition). Workload ADR S, then M–L.
5. **#25446 → B, default off.** A step-level option `excludeSubmitter: true` removes the submitter from the resolved approver set; an emptied set takes the node's existing `onEmptyApprovers` fallback (else ADR-0042 escalation), never a silent pass; the approval record shows when the exclusion changed the route. Off, behaviour is unchanged. Priority p1 (protocol addition). Workload S–M.
6. **#25447 → B, held.** ADR-0138 D5 is the end state (a public form binds to an organization at publish time; the guest anchor's bindings evaluate under it). Timing follows the ADR's own trigger: `pm:on-hold` with `Restart-when: a named hosted deployment (a hotsrm public-notice release or a cloud customer) asks for per-organization public forms`. The maintainer may lift the hold by naming the deployment. Workload when built: M.
7. **#25470 → A.** The Salesforce semantics stay (`modifyAllRecords` implies edit, delete and transfer: `permission-evaluator.ts:76–83`, `:289`; spec fold `permission.zod.ts:214`). The schema refuses, at publish and in lint, an entry that sets `modifyAllRecords: true` beside an explicit `allowDelete: false` (a contradiction, not a declared-but-unenforced key). The docs name the existing route for "edit all, delete none": a `criteria` sharing rule with `accessLevel: 'edit'` to the position on a `public_read` object (`sharing.zod.ts:35`, `:76`; ADR-0111 D3). Whether a rule's `condition` can select every row is unverified — the dev reads it first and the docs state what they find. Not taken: B (rewrites the security fold), shape 2 (a new `editAllRecords` key). Priority p2 stays. Workload S.

**Execution, in this act, by this seat as the `pm:awaiting-maintainer` exit (the seven carried that label without a `Maintainer-action:` line; the ruling is the action they waited on):** #25442 closes not planned · #25443 closes duplicate of #25234 · #25444, #25445, #25446 → `pm:queue` at p1 · #25470 → `pm:queue` at p2 · #25447 → `pm:on-hold` with the `Restart-when:` line. `domain:*` labels stay as triage set them; a lane that needs a spec sub-card files it under this ruling. This card (the decision carrier) closes completed once its body carries the `Ruled:` line; execution lives on the seven.

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：#25442 D 不加开关不翻裁决 G；#25443 B 并入已裁路线；#25444 B 收件人形态进协议一次；#25445 B 先 ADR 再动匿名写入；#25446 B 用已有空审批人回退；#25447 B 按 ADR 自己的触发时机；#25470 A 保持 Salesforce 语义、矛盾声明响亮拒绝、文档指向共享规则路线。
- ② 实际业务拉动：#25442 付费套餐今天就能跑；#25443 零；#25444/#25446/#25470 各两处 hotsrm 实测；#25445 有实测但碰安全边界；#25447 尚无具名部署。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：#25444 只许记录的 email 字段；#25446 默认关；#25470 发布时拒绝矛盾组合、lint 同步；#25445 匿名上传只认表单声明的文件字段。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：两项零工作量、一项挂起、四项开工；全部不加门禁、不加新键。
